question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'study further'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the phrase: The brahmin to________(2) with Parasuram, the renowned scholars. 
 
• **Let's take a look at the options: **
 
 
• **further: ** to a greater degree or extent.**(आगे)**
 
• **across: **from one side to the opposite side of.**(के उस पार)**
 
• **former: **first in order of two or more things.**(पहले वाला)**
 
• **another: **being one more in addition to one or more of the same kind.**(अतिरिक्त/दूसरा)**
 
 
 
• The given blank is demanding something kind of giving the meaning: to extent or continue the study of brahmin.
 
• So,the other options except **further** will not complete the meaning of the phrase.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(1) ** The complete phrase is:* **The brahmin to study further__ with Parasuram,the renowned scholars.***
